component.name: RBD OFİS
component.summary: Free, offline, privacy-first Office and PDF suite

description.p: RBD OFİS is a high-performance, ad-free, completely offline Office & PDF suite built with Rust core architecture.

ul.li: Fast PDF viewing, tile rendering, search, and page editing
Freehand drawing, highlight, sticky note annotations
Document compression, watermarking, bates stamping, page numbering
Interactive AcroForm reading, filling, and flattening
Office document extraction and editing (DOCX, XLSX, PPTX)
Zero network access, zero tracking, strict privacy guaranteed
